Gemini Omni Flash is a preview model designed for fast, conversational video generation and editing. It excels at turning text and images into video, lets you refine and edit generated videos through natural language conversations using the Interactions API. ## Model Description (Gemini Omni Flash Preview)
Google's preview multimodal video model for conversational generation and editing from text, images, and short video inputs.
